summary: Every six months, NASA missions generate enormous volumes of sky survey data containing potential undiscovered worlds. Krishna x Space turns that data into an interactive exploration environment where anyone can search for moving objects, analyze infrared signatures, and participate in real astronomical discovery. By combining scientific rigor, intuitive visualization, and citizen science, the platform transforms billions of data points into opportunities for the next breakthrough discovery.
details:
Krishna x Space is a citizen-science web platform that transforms NASA infrared survey data into an intuitive discovery environment. Using multi-epoch image comparison, blink detection, infrared visualization, and real-time spectral analysis, users can identify moving and ultra-cold objects such as brown dwarfs, trans-Neptunian objects, and potential Planet X candidates.

Built with HTML5 Canvas, JavaScript ES2022, cloud services, and custom visualization architecture, the platform integrates data from SPHEREx, Gaia, and other astronomical archives.

Our innovation combines the historic blink-comparator discovery method with modern infrared astronomy, making complex scientific datasets accessible to both researchers and the public. The team prioritized scientific accuracy, accessibility, usability, open science, and scalable design to empower anyone to participate in astronomical discovery and help uncover previously unknown objects in the Solar System and beyond.
